links.comparator_used: Federated training without differential privacy (undefended gradients); the abstract does not detail the comparison
links.outcome: Information recoverable from reconstructed retinal images under gradient inversion attack
links.effect: No numbers reported for the DP condition in the text. Without DP, over 92% of training-set participants could be identified from reconstructed retinal vessel structure. With DP, substantial information could still be extracted.
links.quote: Furthermore, even with the implementation of differential privacy countermeasures, we show that substantial information can still be extracted from the reconstructed images.
